Class JobServlet

java.lang.Object
jakarta.servlet.GenericServlet
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
com.qm.bupt.servlet.BaseServlet
com.qm.bupt.servlet.JobServlet
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Servlet, jakarta.servlet.ServletConfig, Serializable
@WebServlet("/job") public class JobServlet extends BaseServlet
Servlet handling job posting operations: publishing, listing, updating, deleting, and TA matching.

Mapped to /job?action=xxx. MOs can publish/update/delete their own jobs; all users (including unauthenticated guests) can browse open job listings.
